description: List feedback items (bugs, ideas, comments) people left on a Skyelight project. Returns a summary of the project plus matching items. Start here to see what is outstanding. An item's hand-off (investigate, plan, fix) is set by the team and binding: on investigate or plan, reply on the thread and change no code.

assignee.description: A user id, "me" for whoever this connection belongs to, or "none" for unassigned items.

page.description: Only items on one page, e.g. "/checkout".

projectId.description: Project to read. Optional when a project is bound or the workspace has only one; otherwise the error lists the projects and their ids.

status.description: Defaults to everything. "deferred" is work someone put off until later — outstanding, but deliberately not now.

task.description: Only items a person handed to an agent with this task (Hand off in the app), or "none" for items with no hand-off. Combine with assignee to find your own. Investigate and plan mean reply on the thread with no code changes; fix means make the change.

name: list_items
title: List feedback
